outcome: Malondialdehyde (MDA) levels in cord blood plasma
cohort: The study included 59 newborns born through meconium-stained amniotic fluid and 50 newborns born through clear liquor.
finding: Neonates born through meconium-stained amniotic fluid (MSAF) experienced significantly higher degrees of oxidative stress, as evidenced by increased levels of cord blood plasma MDA and 8-OH-dG, particularly in full-term and late-preterm IUGR neonates.
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured and correlated; included appropriate for gestational age (AGA) and intrauterine growth restricted (IUGR) neonates.
gest_age: Included full-term and late-preterm newborns; gestational age was measured and correlated.
